riders: Each use creates one recorded Karmic Debt owed to the being that granted this Insight. Record the creditor, the event, and one service category: protection, recovery, information, transport, restitution, or aid against a named enemy. A creditor may call in one recorded debt during a meaningful scene. Fulfilling the agreed service clears that debt. Refusing a lawful demand does not retroactively undo the success, but the unresolved debt remains and may become a Bond, oath, or Karma complication through normal story rules. (Outside fights: the fight logs each use; the debt itself is story bookkeeping.)
notes: combat/ext/insight_rewrites.py runs the turned failure through the shared d20_rewrite owner: once per fight (no Full Cultivation Session happens inside a fight), a failed saving throw or Cultivation Check becomes a success, Ask me for players, automatic for AI fighters. Prerequisite and Ability Increase lines are character construction, already applied by the build.

riders:
You have learned a paired practice that harmonizes your cultivation with another willing cultivator.

When you and one eligible partner complete the same 2-hour Full Cultivation Session together:

- both participants restore their Path resources normally;
- both participants may exchange emotional impressions, visions, or spiritual insights by mutual consent;
- each participant may transfer Cultivation Points from one of their active Path pools to the other, up to the transferring character's Proficiency Bonus; and
- each participant gains Advantage on one Cultivation Check made as part of that session or during the next 24 hours to comprehend a lesson that arose from it.

Transferred Cultivation Points cannot raise a pool above its normal maximum. A participant can benefit from only one use of Dual Cultivation between Full Cultivation Sessions. (Outside fights: a shared Full Cultivation Session.)
notes: Outside fights: nothing in this Insight happens during a fight, so the table has nothing to run.

riders:
When you complete a Full Cultivation Session, you may also complete one reconstruction treatment using Body Refining Shared Procedures R1.

- Automatically remove one Tier I ordinary lasting physical Injury whose Source CL is no higher than your Body Refining Source CL.
- For a Tier II Hidden Injury, you may make its treatment check as part of the session and have Advantage if it was already diagnosed.
- A Tier III crippled structure or Tier IV missing limb or organ still requires its printed Reconstruction Progress, project time, a treatment environment meeting the requirements of Body Refining Shared Procedures R1, medicine, ritual aid, and required components. Your personal work counts as a valid Body Refining treatment source.

This Insight cannot automatically reverse Tier V erasure, divine or Immortal authority, Secret effects, Artifacts, soul destruction, heavenly punishment, Foundation destruction, or an effect that expressly requires a breakthrough or story-scale cure. (Outside fights: Injury treatment during a Full Cultivation Session.)

After you use this recovery, you cannot use it again until you complete a normal Full Cultivation Session in a suitable environment. It never functions during Initiative. (Outside fights: meditation and resting; the printed text says it never functions during Initiative.)
